summary.text: Zora is a social app on Base where people post, discover and trade, and each post becomes a tradeable coin.
Zora Labs, a Delaware company founded in 2020, runs it; a cofounder's X post says Dee Goens is taking over as chief executive.
Each account gets one creator coin, and trades in creator or post coins pay a 1% fee.
The ZORA token has a fixed supply of 10 billion on Base and gives no governance or equity rights.
Besides the app and its coin contracts, Zora lists a separate Zora Network website and developer tools.
The project says creator coins trade against ZORA, and post coins trade against their creator's coin.
The project says software attached to each trading pool takes fees automatically and pays creators, referrers and the protocol.
A team wallet needing three of six signers controls the contract that creates new coins; the ZORA token itself has no owner.
Sources disagree on the token's launch date, March or April 2025, and some fee splits were not checked on chain.

lines.quote: Every post becomes an instantly tradeable cryptocurrency token, transforming social media content into a tradeable asset.

lines.text: Zora says each account has one creator coin named after its username.

lines.text: Zora says creator and content coins charge a 1% trading fee.
lines.quote: Creator/Content Coins : 1% (10,000 pips)

lines.text: Zora says trend coins, for trending topics, charge a 0.01% trading fee.
lines.quote: Ultra-low fees - 0.01% (1 bps) trading fee, 100x lower than standard coins

lines.text: Zora says creating a coin with a custom pair has no fee.
lines.quote: No fee to create

lines.text: Zora says developers can earn referral rewards by building coin creation and trading into their apps.
lines.quote: How to earn platform referral (20%) and trade referral (4%) rewards by integrating coin creation and trading.

lines.text: Zora says coins can now be made and traded on Base, Robinhood Chain and Solana.
lines.quote: Available on Base, Robinhood Chain, and Solana

lines.text: Zora says ZORA is a memecoin for the Zora community.
lines.quote: We are excited to announce $ZORA, a memecoin for the Zora community, launching in Spring 2025.

lines.text: Zora says coins are created through its coin factory contract on Base.
lines.quote: This guide covers how to create coins directly using the ZoraFactory contract.

lines.text: Zora says a fee on trades in a coin's first 10 seconds starts at 99% and falls to the base fee.
lines.quote: The fee decays linearly from 99% to the coin's base fee over 10 seconds .

lines.text: Zora says creator and content coins have a fixed supply of 1 billion each.
lines.quote: All coins have a 1 billion token supply with different allocation strategies

lines.text: Zora says half of a creator coin vests to the creator over 5 years and half trades freely.
lines.quote: Creator Vesting 500M tokens Linear vesting over 5 years

lines.text: Zora says a content coin gives 10 million tokens to its creator at launch.
lines.quote: Instant creator allocation - 10M tokens go directly to creators at launch

lines.text: Zora says initial pool liquidity is placed using the Doppler protocol.
lines.quote: Deposits initial liquidity using Doppler protocol for optimized multi-curve positioning

lines.text: Zora keeps an on-chain registry of the Uniswap V4 hook contracts its coins use.
lines.quote: A canonical registry of Zora Uniswap V4 hook addresses to discover and track changes.

lines.text: Zora says creator coins are paired against ZORA.

lines.text: Zora says content coins are paired against their creator's coin.

lines.text: Zora says the hook contract takes fees on each swap and pays rewards automatically.
lines.quote: The latest V4 coins use a UniswapV4 hook to collect fees, swap to a backing currency, and distribute rewards to recipients on every swap.

lines.text: Zora says 20% of creator and content coin fees are kept as permanent pool liquidity.

lines.text: Zora says of total fees the creator gets 50%, platform referrer 20%, trade referrer 4%, Doppler 1%, protocol 5%.
lines.quote: Creator 62.5% 50% Platform Referral 25% 20% Trade Referral 5% 4% Doppler 1.25% 1% Protocol 6.25% 5%

lines.text: Zora says rewards from coin fees are converted and paid out in ZORA.

lines.text: Zora says all trend coin fees go to the protocol.

lines.text: Zora says custom-pair coins pay the creator 0.70% of each trade out of the 1% fee.
lines.quote: 1% trading fee on swaps, with 0.70% going directly to you as the creator, paid instantly to your Zora wallet

differs.why: Zora's help page gives March 11, 2025 as the ZORA token generation event, while crypto.news reported launch on April 23, 2025; this may be minting vs airdrop/trading date.
The MiCA white paper names Jacob Horne as chief executive; a later X post from @js_horne says Dee Goens is taking over as CEO. L34 is marked outdated by L66, pending a zora.co source.

open_questions: Which wallet deployed the ZORA token and coin factory? Blockscout returned a bot check and Routescan does not serve Base, so no deployer proof was made.
Who controls the ZORA token's 10 billion supply distribution, and do on-chain balances match the stated team, investor and treasury unlocks?
Are the stated fee splits (50/20/4/1/5 and 20% liquidity) enforced by the current hook contracts? Not checked on chain.
What is the ZORA contract on Solana and how is it bridged to Base?
Is Zora Network (zora.energy, an Ethereum L2 per DefiLlama) still operated and how does it relate to the Base coins?
Why do March 11, 2025 (Zora) and April 23, 2025 (crypto.news) differ as launch dates?
Does a zora.co channel confirm that Dee Goens is now chief executive? Only the @js_horne X post says so; the MiCA white paper still names Jacob Horne.
Who holds the six signer wallets of the factory's owner Safe? The addresses are read on chain but no source names them.

notes: Folded in [F1] (page shown, 61 lines L1-L61, all carried with the same ids) and [F2] (changes result: line N1 carried as L66; its patch applied to the summary's who-runs-it sentence and to the Founder row, which now names Zora Labs only, with people in Contributors). Nothing was dropped. Main contract: the ZORA token on Base, because Zora's help centre names it as the official contract, creator coins pair against it and rewards are paid in it. Channel ties re-checked on 2026-11-22: support.zora.co article 5638529 calls its list of X, Farcaster, Instagram and TikTok accounts and zora.energy official, so those ties change from none to linked; Zora's docs link github.com/ourzora/zora-protocol as its protocol repository, so GitHub is linked too. Two Farcaster channels from that list were added. No line yet rests on a linked channel's own posts. The @js_horne post (L66) stays a claim: that account is not on Zora's official list. It is written by its handle only; no identity is inferred beyond what the post says. All proofs re-read on the free public Base RPC at block 60577931; values matched the block 60145088 readings, which are kept in history. Two proofs were added (token code size, factory Safe signers and version). The earlier Price row, a token market price, was removed because market prices are not allowed as rows; the CoinGecko line L32 is kept. A Size row was added from DefiLlama. Deployed by is left out: Blockscout returned a bot check and Routescan does not support Base, so no deployer proof exists. Seats does not apply. Lines are facts (proofs), project statements (from zora.co and its subdomains) or outside claims; inferences are kept out of lines, conflicts are in differs and gaps in open_questions.
